purpose: Desktop FP16-enabled TensorRT comparison of the deterministic seed-42 original and scene-aware models
performance_scope: Desktop RTX 3060 TensorRT FP16 enabled; batch one; one engine build per model; matching input and timing procedure; not Orin or end-to-end.
parity_scope: Compare each engine with its matching PyTorch checkpoint on all 445 tuning images, including output-difference outliers.
limitations: Seed 42 only; tuning previously inspected; unknown original pretraining overlap; one desktop environment. This follow-up was planned after earlier nondeterministic results, not a blinded hypothesis.
